purpose: Authoritative evidence and candidate-selection rules for the zero-extension BEM study.

rules.evidence: The retained practical design domain requested for this study is 30-50 degrees and 250-450 mm.
36 completed remote candidates produced no competitive design; the median score delta was -10.18 points and the low/low and high/high strata were boundary confirmations.
Across 110 quarter-step-K Phase 3 candidates, the selected winner's median advantage over a nearby coarse K value was 0.05 score points and the maximum was 0.14.
Fixed K=4, N=10 S grids already sample the local length axis in every retained mouth/coverage cell.
At 30 degrees and 250 mm, L=200.597 mm and K=3, changing N from 6 to 14 changes normalized radius by only 0.41% RMS (1.07% maximum). The nominal N separation is not independent physical information.
The study maps controls and diagnostics; it does not spend solves resolving local score changes smaller than practical relevance.
